notes: This software archive is the public PicoTorch source tree. Training remains on PC PyTorch. Raw WISDM and CIFAR-10 archives, PlatformIO .pio trees, and ESP-IDF managed_components are not redistributed. Pico-Former is an independently developed glucose application, archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22218446.
description:
This software archive provides PicoTorch, an open-source unified machine-learning framework that shortens the path from a research prototype to a constrained embedded platform. The first host is ESP32-S3. The on-device interface assembles a Module graph (Linear, LayerNorm, multi-head attention, feed-forward, Sequential) and runs one forward. Fused self-attention and cross-attention are implemented in this library in hardware FP32. PicoTorch does not call Espressif ESP-DL, ESP-NN, or ESP-PPQ.

It belongs to the same class of on-device inference frameworks as the Espressif INT8/INT16 stack and LiteRT Micro, and supplies the hardware-FP32 forward path that the official Espressif stack does not provide. On one ESP32-S3 and one WISDM weight set, PicoTorch FP32 reports a burn-in median of 30.9 ms and 47.5 KB of working SRAM against LiteRT Micro FP32 at 169.7 ms and 88.5 KB, with Top-1 agreement 1.000 on both sides. The Espressif INT8 official path reports 9.8 ms and is listed as a separate precision tier.

Included materials

  • Public C++ headers and kernels (include/picotorch/, src/)
  • Five host call programs in examples/minimal/
  • WISDM 6-class Encoder and CIFAR-10 Conv+Encoder examples, with exported FP32 weights and contrast firmware for LiteRT Micro and ESP-DL INT8
  • PicoTorch glucose application example (counterpart: Pico-Former)
  • Programming guide and host max-abs checks

Data boundary

Raw WISDM Actitracker and CIFAR-10 archives are obtained from their original providers. PlatformIO .pio/ trees and ESP-IDF managed_components/ are generated locally. Those artifacts are not part of this deposit.

Companion archives

  • Pico-Former: 10.5281/zenodo.22218446
  • RICE-Former: 10.5281/zenodo.22171786
